title: Need to refactor the test_bgp_speaker.py to take advantage of enhanced fixtures
author: wangxin

**Description**
The BGP Speaker testing has been refactored to use the pytest script. In case we want to re-use the existing testbed.csv, the BGP speaker case would fail with creating PTF Ansible host because the existing testbeds.csv does not have the "ptf" column.
The testbed_devices fixture in sonic-mgmt/tests/conftest.py has been enhanced to look for PTF information from the inventory file in case testbeds.csv does not have the ptf column.
The test_bgp_speaker.py script can be enhanced to take advantange of the testbed_device fixture.
Otherwise, it may fail with below error:

Summary:
Fixes #1234
Change:
* Replace AnsibleHost with new duthost and ptfhost fixtures to be consistent
  with other platform pytest scripts. We can gradually deprecate the AnsibleHost
  class. With the new fixtures we can run the script with old testbed.csv file
  which does not have the "ptf" column.
* Refactor the script to use setup teardown pattern
* Break the testing into two sub-cases
* Add workaround for known issue https://github.com/Azure/SONiC/issues/387
  Otherwise the ptf test will fail.
* Add more logging
* Improve cleanup
